#### Description
In `MacdAlphaModel.OnSecuritiesChanged`, a missing `ContainsKey` is not preventing a second key addition to a dictionary.

#### Related Issue
Closes #2656

#### Motivation and Context
Framework models should not throw.

#### Requires Documentation Change
No.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Executes `CustomFrameworkModelsAlgorithm` in the cloud with a different `EndDate`.

pr_comments: fyi, it may still be possible to receive multiple added securities events -- this definitely used to hold true for multiple universes selecting the same security (the original intent of the event was notifying that a universe added the security, not that the algorithm added the security). We would certainly want to confirm this behavior, so it may be nice to leave the containskey check in there for robustness?

issue_context.title: Addition of existing key to dictionary in MacdAlphaModel
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
Framework models should not throw exceptions.

#### Actual Behavior
In `MacdAlphaModel.OnSecuritiesChanged`, when a security is added more than once to the model, it tries to add it to a dictionary that has an existing key.

#### Potential Solution
Add `ContainsKey` check.

#### Reproducing the Problem
Executes `CustomFrameworkModelsAlgorithm` in the cloud with a different `EndDate`. 

#### System Information
No.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)
- [x] I have provided detailed steps to reproduce the issue

review_comments: Can you give some details about why this appears to be adding a second time?
